data_description.dataset_passphrases: Enter DatasetName#PassPhrase pairs (one per line, e.g. tank/encrypted#MySecret) to add or update stored passphrases. Leave empty to keep existing passphrases unchanged. Use the passphrase_remove action to delete a stored passphrase by its dataset path.

migrate.title: Existing TrueNAS configuration found
migrate.description: A previous TrueNAS integration was detected. You can take over its settings (host, API key and options) so you don't have to enter them again — your existing entities and their history are preserved. Or set up TrueNAS CE from scratch.

error.http_used: The plain HTTP request was sent to HTTPS port. Reverse proxy?
error.proxy_intercepted: Connection intercepted by a reverse proxy or SSO portal (e.g. Cloudflare Access). Point the integration at the TrueNAS host directly over your LAN/VPN, or exempt the WebSocket endpoint from the proxy's authentication.
error.invalid_hostname: Invalid host. Enter only the hostname or IP address — without "https://", path or trailing slash.
error.handshake_timeout: Connection failed, timed out while waiting for handshake response.
error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to host (TCP port {port} closed or timeout).
error.unknown_dataset: Unknown dataset path. Verify the spelling and try again.
error.passphrase_malformed_line: Malformed passphrase entry (missing '#') on line '{line}'. Each line must be in the format: DatasetName#Passphrase.
error.passphrase_empty_value: Empty passphrase is not allowed on line '{line}'. Each line must be in the format: DatasetName#Passphrase.

init.title: Clean up orphaned TrueNAS statistics
init.description: {count} long-term statistic(s) belong to TrueNAS entities that no longer exist (they show as "no state available" in Developer Tools > Statistics). Choose what to do.

init.title: Roll back the TrueNAS CE migration?
init.description: TrueNAS Community Edition adopted {count} entity(ies) and their history from your previous TrueNAS integration, which is now disabled (not deleted). Keep TrueNAS CE, or roll back to hand the entities and history back to the old integration. Rolling back removes the TrueNAS CE integration. This is only possible while the old integration still exists.

menu_options.rollback: Roll back to the previous integration
